card.doneApprover: You approve the move to Done

drag.picked: {{key}} picked up in {{column}}, position {{position}} of {{total}}. The arrows move it, Space drops it and Escape cancels.

why.project: a graph runs in one project

empty.title: No tasks yet

empty.hint: to create a task from any view of the board
empty.filteredBody: Nothing on the board matches these filters.
empty.offBody: {{project}} has its Board module off. Its tasks are kept: switch the module on in the project's settings to see them again.
empty.noneBody: Switch on the Board module of a project to follow its tasks here.
empty.bodyShort: The board of {{project}} is empty. Create the first task here, or from a message in any chat.

all.note: Each card names its project. No limits per column: each project sets its own, and they show once you choose it.
all.noLimits: No limits per column: each project has its own.

list.title: Title
list.order: Ordered by their place on the board

milestones.explain: A milestone groups tasks; its progress comes from them, with no dates.
milestones.deleteBody: Its tasks are kept, without a milestone.
milestones.noneRow_one: {{count}} open task is in no milestone
milestones.noneRow_other: {{count}} open tasks are in no milestone
milestones.emptyBody: A milestone groups tasks toward a goal, such as a release, with no date. Its progress comes from its tasks.
milestones.name: Name
milestones.nameHint: A version or a goal, such as v0.20
milestones.descriptionHint: Markdown. What the milestone is for.
milestones.failed: The milestone could not be saved
milestones.changeFailed: The milestone could not be changed
milestones.pickProject: Choose a project to create a milestone in it

suggest.title: Suggest tasks
suggest.focusPlaceholder: What to look for, such as what is left to close v0.20
suggest.first: The assistant reads the project, read-only, and proposes tasks, each with its reason. Nothing is created until you choose.
suggest.waiting: The proposals show here once it has read the project, each with its reason
suggest.waitingShort: waiting · they show once the reading ends
suggest.closeHint: You can close this window: the suggestion goes on in its chat and tells you when it ends.
suggest.phoneHint: Only the ones you include are created in Backlog. The cost counts in Usage, like any chat's.
suggest.likeHint: Proposals like a task that already exists start unselected.
suggest.flowRuns_one: The flow will queue {{count}} run: {{role}} refines the task in Backlog.
suggest.flowRuns_other: The flow will queue {{count}} runs, {{parallel}} at a time: {{role}} refines each task in Backlog.
suggest.failed: It ended without a readable answer.
suggest.nothing: It read the project and found nothing new to propose.
suggest.emptyProject: There is nothing to read in this project yet: say what it is for in the field above and suggest again.

queued.refine: Queued: it will be refined when there is room
queued.check: Queued: it will be checked when there is room
queued.work: Queued: it will be implemented when there is room
queued.verify: Queued: it will be verified when there is room

strip.queuedTitle: Waiting for a place under the runs-at-once limit

cause.budget: it reached the cost limit per run
cause.rate-limit: its provider reached its usage limit
cause.limit-wait-expired: the limit did not reset in time
cause.max-tokens: it was cut off at the token limit
cause.not-continued: its chat could not go on after a restart
cause.chat-ended: its chat ended without a result
cause.chat-failed: its chat ended in an error

strip.chatWaiting: Your chat waits for your answer

pr.awaiting: Approved · its {{noun}} opens when the verification passes

auto.note: merges on its own once the checks pass · {{method}}
auto.noteBare: merges on its own once the checks pass

fix.push: fix verified, waiting to be pushed

verifying.person: pushed on its own if QA passes it

error.fetch: the default branch could not be fetched
error.merge: the default branch could not be merged into its branch
error.push: its branch could not be pushed
error.commit: what was left could not be committed

notReady.not-git: the project is not a git repository
notReady.no-remote: the project has no origin remote
notReady.unsupported-host: Agentry cannot reach {{host}}: neither gh nor glab is signed in to it
notReady.cli-missing: {{cli}} is not installed, or Agentry cannot find it

refused.busy: A chat or a flow run is working on it

checkout.behind_other: The working copy is {{count}} commits behind origin/{{base}}
